title: Calendar Filter – Course Selection – SF Calendar – Classes Auto-Populated in Unchecked State
description: AC 01.1, BR-1 — Decision Table — Confirms that on the SF Mana Calendar, selecting a course auto-populates the class list with all classes under that course in unchecked state.
preconditions:
- Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE
- "Course A – Introduction to Math" has 3 classes: Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma
- Group lessons G1 (Class Alpha), G2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta), G3 (Class Beta), G4 (Class Gamma) exist in the current week
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions:
1. Open the SF Mana Calendar and open the filter panel
2. Select "Course A – Introduction to Math" in the Course filter
3. Observe the Class filter section
4. Observe the checkbox state of each class
steps_result:
1. Filter panel opens; Class section is not visible
2. Course A is selected
3. Class section appears; Class Alpha, Class Beta, and Class Gamma are listed
4. All 3 classes are in unchecked state — no class checkbox is checked
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Course Selection – Class Auto-Population

title: Calendar Filter – Course Selection – SF Calendar – Auto-Populated Classes Not Active Until Manually Checked
description: AC 01.1, BR-3 — Decision Table (Critical) — Confirms that after course selection auto-populates the class list, the SF Calendar is NOT filtered by class. All course lessons remain visible until the user explicitly checks a class.
preconditions: - Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE\n- "Course A" has 3 classes; Group lessons G1–G4 (all Course A) exist in the current week\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions:
1. Open SF Mana Calendar with no filter applied
2. Note the total number of Course A lessons visible
3. Select "Course A – Introduction to Math" in the Course filter
4. Observe the calendar without checking any class
5. Confirm all class checkboxes remain unchecked
steps_result:
1. All 4 Group lessons for Course A (G1, G2, G3, G4) are visible
2. 4 lessons confirmed visible
3. Course A selected; Class section appears with Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma — all unchecked
4. Calendar still shows all 4 Course A lessons — the lesson count has NOT changed
5. Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma are all unchecked; no class filter is active
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Course Selection – Class Auto-Population

title: Calendar Filter – Course Selection – Class Scope – Classes Outside Current Date Range Listed in Filter
description: BR-13 — Equivalence Partitioning — Confirms the auto-populated class list contains ALL classes system-wide linked to the selected course, including classes whose lessons fall outside the current calendar date range.
preconditions:
- Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE
- "Course A – Introduction to Math" has 4 classes: Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma, Class Zeta
- Class Zeta's lessons under Course A are all scheduled 3 months ago (not visible in the current week)
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- SF Mana Calendar is showing the current week
steps_actions: 1. Open SF Mana Calendar showing the current week\n2. Select "Course A – Introduction to Math" in the Course filter\n3. Observe the full class list in the filter panel
steps_result: 1. Current week displayed; Class Zeta's lessons are not visible on the calendar\n2. Course A is selected\n3. Class list shows Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma, and Class Zeta — all 4 classes appear including Class Zeta whose lessons are not in the current view
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Course Selection – Class Auto-Population

title: Calendar Filter – Course Selection – Course with No Associated Classes – Empty Class Section Displayed
description: AC 01.1 edge case — Boundary Value Analysis — Confirms that selecting a course with 0 associated classes shows an empty class section without error or crash.
preconditions:
- Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE
- "Course C – Empty Course" exists and has 0 associated classes
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- SF Mana Calendar filter panel is open
steps_actions: 1. In the Calendar filter, select "Course C – Empty Course"\n2. Observe the Class section in the filter panel\n3. Confirm no error message, crash, or indefinite loading spinner
steps_result: 1. Course C is selected\n2. The Class section appears but displays an empty list (e.g. "No classes available" message or empty container)\n3. Filter panel remains stable; no error toast, no spinner frozen, no blank page
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Course Selection – Class Auto-Population
